categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Sun-Novo Pharmaceutical Research Co., Ltd. operates primarily as a Contract Research Organization (CRO) providing comprehensive drug research and development services. Its main segments include pharmaceutical research services, clinical trial and bioanalysis services, and equity participation in drug development projects. The company focuses on innovative drug development, generic drug development, and consistency evaluation services, covering drug discovery, pharmacology, pharmaceutical research, clinical trials, and bioanalysis.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as Computer-Aided Drug Design (CADD), Artificial Intelligence-Driven Drug Design (AIDD), and proprietary platforms like iCVETide® for peptide drug discovery and BiMTtide® for peptide-drug conjugates. It has established platforms for controlled-release formulations, peptide and small nucleic acid drug development, and transdermal drug delivery systems (TDDS). The company also employs GLP and GCP standards in clinical and preclinical research, with capabilities in pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, immunogenicity, and biomarker analysis.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sun-Novo serves approximately 1,000 domestic pharmaceutical companies and research institutions, including large and medium-sized drug manufacturers. Its services cater to clients engaged in innovative drug development, generic drug production, and clinical research. The company’s end markets span multiple therapeutic areas such as oncology, cardiovascular, endocrine, respiratory, pain management, pediatrics, and rare diseases.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with its headquarters and major R&D facilities located in Beijing. It maintains a nationwide clinical trial network with 19 permanent sites and collaborations with over 300 hospitals across China. The company is also actively pursuing international market expansion and global clinical trial participation.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sun-Novo functions as a midstream service provider in the pharmaceutical R&D supply chain, offering outsourced drug discovery, preclinical research, clinical trial management, and bioanalytical services. It acts as a critical intermediary between pharmaceutical innovators and regulatory approval, facilitating drug development from early discovery through clinical phases to market registration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include expanding integrated 'preclinical + clinical' drug development services, enhancing AI-driven drug discovery platforms, and advancing innovative drug pipelines in peptides, nucleic acids, and cell therapies. It emphasizes building proprietary technology platforms, increasing R&D investment (15.94% of revenue), and cultivating high-quality talent. The firm also focuses on international patent protection, global market expansion, and deepening collaborations for pipeline development and commercialization.
categories.revenue_model: Sun-Novo generates revenue primarily through fee-for-service contracts for drug discovery, preclinical studies, clinical trials, and bioanalysis. It recognizes income based on project milestones or progress, with some projects including equity participation and future sales revenue sharing. The company also receives government subsidies and investment income from equity holdings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic CRO with strong capabilities in integrated drug development services. It competes with multinational CROs like IQVIA and Covance, as well as large Chinese CROs such as WuXi AppTec, Pharmaron, Tigermed, and Joinn. While smaller in scale compared to industry giants, Sun-Novo differentiates itself through specialized technology platforms, comprehensive service offerings, and a focus on innovative drug development.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Sun-Novo reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.08 billion, a 15.7% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 177.4 million, slightly down by 3.98%. The company’s total assets reached nearly RMB 2 billion, growing 6.67% from the prior year. R&D investment increased by 39.02%, accounting for 15.94% of revenue, reflecting a strong growth trajectory focused on innovation and service expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sun-Novo offers a one-stop integrated drug R&D service platform combining preclinical and clinical research, supported by advanced AI and computational drug design technologies. Its differentiation lies in proprietary peptide and nucleic acid drug discovery platforms, comprehensive quality control systems, and a broad therapeutic coverage including innovative and complex drug modalities. The company’s strong talent pool, extensive clinical network, and strategic equity participation model provide clients with efficient, high-quality, and customizable drug development solutions.
